'''Gwieth Brothers''' was an arms manufacturer that made [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launchers]]. Gweith Brothers launchers were extremely powerful, but had a very slow rate of fire. [[Rusher's Brigade]] often used concussion missile launchers made by Gweith Brothers.
